summary: First-finish smoke test of +58BarberStudio. Backend endpoints (business, services, auth, working-hours, availability, appointments, blockers, clients) verified via public URL. Frontend Home, protected /admin route, admin login (wrong+right), booking wizard end-to-end (4 steps -> WhatsApp confirmation) all functional.
passed: GET /api/business returns business info (name, phone, whatsapp, instagram, address)
GET /api/services returns 6 seeded services with id/name/price_eur/duration_min
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401; correct -> JWT + user{role:admin}
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer -> admin user; without token -> 401
GET /api/availability returns 40 slots for tomorrow (10 min service)
POST /api/appointments with accepted_policy=false -> 400 'Debes aceptar la política del 50%'
Double-booking same slot -> 409 'Esa hora ya no está disponible'
GET /api/availability after booking excludes taken slot (40 -> 39)
POST /api/appointments/{id}/cancel wrong phone -> 403; correct phone (>12h) -> 200 ok
GET /api/clients (admin) lists client with appointments_count=1; anon -> 401
POST /api/blockers full-day (start=null,end=null) -> /api/availability returns 0 slots for that date; DELETE blocker -> 200
Frontend / loads: hero-book-btn visible, 6 service cards, floating contact buttons visible
Frontend admin login: wrong pw stays on login; correct credentials navigates to /admin dashboard with tabs (Agenda/Servicios/Horario/Bloqueos/Clientes) visible

Frontend /reservar 4-step wizard completes: pick service -> pick date -> pick time -> fill name/phone -> policy required (submit without policy does NOT create appointment) -> with policy shows success screen with wa.me confirm-whatsapp-btn
action_items: Note: review_request documented booking payload keys as 'time'/'name'/'phone' but actual API schema uses 'start'/'client_name'/'client_phone' (per server.py AppointmentIn). Frontend already uses correct schema. No fix needed—just documentation clarification for future testers.
